notes: Afternoon refresh: all 30 pots were reviewed against the live workbook read at 4:49 p.m. Eastern on September 15. Twenty-five new measured weights were saved from approximately 4:20 to 4:37 p.m.; no new Water events were present.

All 20 pots watered September 14 now have their first post-water weights: A1–F3, G1 and G2. Their missing-baseline follow-ups are complete. No repeat weighing or watering is requested for them tonight.

The new baselines were taken about 20 hours after the September 14 watering at approximately 8:30 p.m. They are the first observed weights in this cycle, not immediate after-soak measurements. Retain that elapsed time when comparing wet references between cycles.

Five weigh-ins remain for tonight: #1, #2, #3, #5 and #6. #3 needs its first post-water weight; #5 and #6 need fresh curve evidence. #1 and #2 are lower-priority flexible samples that were already due today.

H1, H2 and H3 remain Check / Water candidates through reached dry references. No current curve meets the sustained-plateau criteria. H3 has one unchanged interval; that alone does not establish a plateau.

G3 was weighed today and remains Check only because its leaf cycle controls watering. #4 was also weighed: 851 g is 10 g above its dry reference. No repeat weight is needed tonight; reweigh September 16 within its September 15–17 observation window.

Watering candidates use plain RO without nutrients. Record a comparable post-drain weight only for pots actually watered. These conditional measurements are separate from the five unfinished weigh-ins.

All live model cells match the shared detector. No active trend-review flags, duplicate Observation IDs or formula errors were found. The three remaining calibration gaps are #3 without a wet reference and #5/#6 without completed dry references.
